answer: Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 7 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. Because the walnut reference is updated at each karst checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the knoll audit records how much each answer added. Repeating an already-covered mechanism therefore earns nothing extra, so one template cannot forfeit for 43 aliases however many keys the operator holds. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
